theme: Token copies, token replacement and gifts
reuse: Replacement on RepEventCreateTokens: effects/token_replacements.go, xorn.go (additive group — Chatterfang's 'plus that many Squirrels'), moonlit_meditation.go / mirrormind_crown.go (optional 'instead create that many copies' — Esix), ReplaceTokenKinds in game/token_create.go (Fisher's Talent Fish->Shark->Octopus; Class levels: *_talent.go); gift: effects/gift.go has GiftACard/AFood/ATappedFish/ATreasure — add 'Gift an Octopus' (8/8 blue Octopus, same token as Fisher's Talent level 3; kiora_the_rising_tide.go has one) and 'Gift an extra turn' (Perch Protection; extra turns: docs 'Extra turns', game/move_extra_turn.go) here and only here; 'your life total can't change' + player protection from everything: teferis_protection.go; token copy of a dying creature with changes (Brenard, Nightmare Shepherd): token_copy.go; Mimic Vat imprint: copy_of_exiled_with.go; delayed copy-on-entry this turn (Theoretical Duplication): delayed_bodies.go.

cards.name: Chatterfang, Squirrel General
cards.oracle_text:
Forestwalk (This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Forest.)
If one or more tokens would be created under your control, those tokens plus that many 1/1 green Squirrel creature tokens are created instead.
{B}, Sacrifice X Squirrels: Target creature gets +X/-X until end of turn.

cards.name: Esix, Fractal Bloom
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
The first time you would create one or more tokens during each of your turns, you may instead choose a creature other than Esix and create that many tokens that are copies of that creature.

related.name: Copy
related.oracle_text: (This token can be used to represent a token that's a copy of a permanent.)

cards.name: Fisher's Talent
cards.oracle_text:
(Gain the next level as a sorcery to add its ability.)
At the beginning of your upkeep, look at the top card of your library. You may reveal it if it's a land card. Create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token if you revealed it this way. Then draw a card.
{G}{U}: Level 2
If you would create a Fish token, create a 3/3 blue Shark creature token instead.
{2}{G}{U}: Level 3
If you would create a Shark token, create an 8/8 blue Octopus creature token instead.

cards.name: Octomancer
cards.oracle_text:
Gift an Octopus (You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, when it enters, they create an 8/8 blue Octopus creature token.)
At the beginning of each end step, create a token that's a copy of target creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.

cards.name: Perch Protection
cards.oracle_text:
Gift an extra turn (You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they take an extra turn after this one.)
Create four 2/2 blue Bird creature tokens with flying. If the gift was promised, all permanents you control phase out, and until your next turn, your life total can't change and you gain protection from everything.
Exile Perch Protection.
